title: Unveiling the reaction mechanism and the regioselectivity of Diels–Alder cycloadditions between 2-methoxy-3-thiophenylbutadiene and methyl vinyl ketone using topological tools
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17283-17294
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00118A, Paper

Mohamed Chellegui, Sabir A. Mohammed Salih, Lakhdar Benhamed, Haydar A. Mohammad-Salimd, Ali Ben Ahmed
DFT study of the [4 + 2] Diels–Alder reaction between 1 and 2 reveals a nucleophilic diene and electrophilic dienophile. The process follows a non-polar, one-step asynchronous mechanism favoring the ortho/endo pathway.
